tool_args.rationale: The pilot shows sink-gradient dependence, and the acquired long-horizon observations show reversal. Fit the documented five-parameter sink-coupled dual-horizon law numerically and test it on fresh confirmation.

considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The observed long-horizon sign reversal and the documented sink-coupled adaptation mechanism favor the dual-horizon model; the existing eight rows support fitting it.
The acquired slow-horizon measurements address the principal extrapolation ambiguity, so another probe is not yet justified.
It cannot account for the transition from positive short-horizon responses to negative long-horizon responses.
